_why._note: Low heights (5-10 m): py + (b). Hold's whole-picture path (most fixes at 5-10 m) with the low-height fix and the yaw solve, and Hold's attitude yaw taken from the FC as sent. Use all values together, and only for a hold at 5-10 m: at 60 m py + (b) was worse than base in 2 of 3 seeds (30 s RMS 0.59 / 0.44 / 0.39 m against 0.49 / 0.41 / 0.47 m; sent fixes more than 0.5 m wrong 9 / 40 / 0 against 2 / 0 / 12), and the FC yaw error at the switch was bent in the climb in 3 of 3 (-7.1 / -5.3 / -3.4 deg against -0.6 / -0.1 / +0.6 deg); at 20 m (1 seed) no gain (0.44 against 0.38 m); at 30 m, 2 seeds: no gain and no clear harm (0.42 / 0.40 against 0.45 / 0.40 m; over 60 s 0.41 / 0.47 against 0.42 / 0.44 m). dense_turn without att_source gyro_fcyaw bent the FC yaw by up to 11.7 degrees in SITL (FC yaw error -1.8 -> +9.9 deg, still +5.7 deg at 60 s; integ/kfmap/closed/ab_table.txt). Never use dense_turn alone. Evidence and limits: integ/kfmap/README.txt. Simulation only (ArduCopter SITL, TUNING ground and seeds; no PX4 run, no real flight). Apply it without this overlay to switch it off.
_why.hold_cfg.dense_local: true: J at the last fix and the halves gap in px of each half's own texture (integ/lowh/proposed.patch, bit for bit: integ/kfmap/README.txt section 2). Closed loop 5 m (integ/lowh/closed/ab_table.txt, 3 seeds): halves refusals 123 -> 24, re-anchors 14 -> 4, longest gap 3.34 -> 1.38 s. Cost: tests_apb/test_live.py hover 10 m seed 12 gap 0.33 s (limit 0.3 s); half-frozen pictures at 5 m give more Hold fixes (integ/lowh/README.txt 5a).
_why.hold_cfg.dense_turn: true: the whole-picture path also solves the yaw turn (integ/diag10 'yaw', bit for bit: integ/kfmap/README.txt section 2b). ArduCopter SITL 10 m w20g40, seeds 1 and 2, 30 s from the switch, with att_source gyro_fcyaw: RMS 0.42 / 0.33 m against base 0.79 / 0.71 m, max 0.84 / 0.74 against 1.39 / 1.12 m, sent-fix error 0.11 / 0.04 against 0.77 / 0.73 m, longest gap 0.41 / 0.16 against 1.31 / 1.38 s (integ/kfmap/closed/ab_table.txt). 5-10 m over all 17 pairs (TUNING ottawa2019fall seeds 1-3; VALIDATION ottawa2022 seeds 11-13 and farmland seeds 11-13 at 10 m, ottawa2022 11-13 and farmland 11-12 at 5 m; integ/kfmap/closed/pairs.txt): lower RMS in 16 of 17, 0 sent fixes more than 0.5 m wrong in 21 of 21 runs (base: up to 256 of 334). Only with att_source gyro_fcyaw (see _note). test_live with py + (b): the known overlay FAIL (22 fixes against 21), freeze noise 11 of 72 frames sent, last fix 0.84 s after the freeze (limit 1.0 s; off 7 of 72, 0.50 s).
_why.hold_cfg.dense_nadir_deg: 0 = off. 55 (diag10 pyn55) had the same median but a worse worst case on the validation replays (integ/diag10/README.txt 03:38); not run in closed loop.
_why.hold_cfg.kf_map: false: the keyframe map was stopped before its tests; its false-relocalization rate is not measured (integ/kfmap/README.txt section 5).
_why.att_source: gyro_fcyaw = (b) of the lead: roll and pitch from GyroAtt, yaw as the FC sends it (apb_main.py). With dense_turn it kept the FC yaw error change at 2.2 / 1.6 deg in 30 s (10 m, seeds 1 and 2); with the default gyro it was 8.7 / 11.7 deg.
